tool.name: list-countries
tool.description: Lists all countries with ISO code and name. Country names are in english

tool.name: get-country-name
tool.description: Gets the name of a country for a given ISO country code. Country name is in english.
tool.statement: select COUNTRY_NAME from COUNTRIES where COUNTRY_ID = :COUNTRY_ID

tool.name: get-employee-info
tool.statement: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, l.city, e.salary, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.city ORDER BY e.salary DESC) as salary_rank FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id JOIN locations l ON d.location_id = l.location_id where e.EMPLOYEE_ID = :EMPLOYEE_ID ORDER BY l.city, salary_rank
